summary: Workflow: go/no-go release check across tests, compatibility, security and reliability.
intents: is this build ready to release
run a go or no-go check before we ship
check everything that should block this release
release gate review for the new version
prerequisites: test report, API specs and SLO data if available

steps.goal: Confirm the test report has no failures or errors
Check API changes for breaking changes and the version bump
Check for new secrets, flagged dependencies and container issues
Confirm the error budget allows a release
Write release notes, rollout plan and rollback trigger

done_when: A go or no-go decision is stated with the evidence behind it
Every blocking issue has an owner
A rollback trigger and procedure are written down
